The short list

This weekend

25–26 July · Winter

July sits in the quieter stretch of Peninsula winter, and that is the point. The lead booking is a truffle hunt at Red Hill. Sunday is for the sculpture park at Pt Leo.

  • Pick one

    Red Hill Truffles, winter hunt

    Main Ridge

    Peak Périgord black season. The guided hunt and lunch puts you in the grove with a trained dog, and at a table afterwards. The most considered way to spend a cold Peninsula morning.

    Booking required · Saturday spots fill

  • Pick two

    Pt Leo Estate Sculpture Park

    Merricks

    Sixteen and a half acres, sixty-plus contemporary works, two walking loops through a Merricks winery. Walk the outer loop first, then slow down for the inner. It rewards a slow pace rather than a ticked list.

    No booking · Open daily

  • The weather-proof one

    Helen Britton, The Story So Far

    MPRG, Mornington

    MPRG’s winter season is open, with Natalia Milosz-Piekarska alongside. Central Mornington, free entry, good coffee close. A grey Saturday morning here is a reasonable plan in its own right.

    Free entry · Closed Mondays
